0.content: Rost was the experienced hunter who raised Aloy in the rugged mountains near the tribe that had cast her out. Stern but kind and generous, he trained her in the hunt, but he could not tell her the one thing she most wanted: why she was an outcast and who her parents were. When assassins struck the Proving, Rost sacrificed himself so she could escape. Aloy still misses him and hopes he would be proud of who she has become. He was "a great hunter. And an even better man."

1.content: In Aloy's world, the Proving was her tribe's annual hunting contest; the winner could ask a reward of the High Matriarchs, the only people who knew why she had been exiled. Aloy trained all her life to win it and learn who her parents were. The ritual ended in a massacre: mysterious assassins killed the participating hunters. She later learned she had been their real target, because her face almost exactly matched that of an enigmatic ancient woman. Her Genshin constellation, Nora Fortis ("Nora Brave"), nods to her tribe.

2.content:
HADES was an artificial intelligence "filled with malice, bent on cleansing the world of all life". To stop it, Aloy followed her link to the ancient woman who shared her face. Exploring the ruins of the distant past, she discovered she had not been born of flesh and blood but cloned from the genes of the woman who saved all life a thousand years earlier. That inheritance gave her abilities from birth and made her the key to preventing a second apocalypse. With allies from many tribes she defeated HADES and its human and machine followers in a decisive battle at the shining city of Meridian.

Aloy spent her life looking for a mother and "never found her, not really". Instead she found ancient messages from the woman she was cloned from, and they felt as if that woman knew her and knew how to inspire her. She describes the fight with HADES wryly: the people trying to end the world are always full of themselves and act as if you are the one in the wrong.

3.content: After defeating HADES, Aloy travelled her world searching every Old World ruin for the Old Ones' lost secrets. In one dilapidated laboratory she found a gleaming portal. Powerful energy enveloped her; she saw her own reflection inside it and felt as if she were in two places at once. In a flash her world vanished and she found herself in Teyvat. Canon does not say who made the portal, whether it can be reopened, or whether anyone in Teyvat knows how she arrived.

4.content:
Aloy met the Traveler as a stranger in a world she did not understand and came to call them a true friend, something she rarely says. She sees a kindred spirit: someone talented who honed their skills through adventure, and another outlander from another world. She has heard the stories of the dragon in Mondstadt and the sea god in Liyue and admires that the Traveler always joins those who fight back. When the Traveler mentioned their missing sibling, she promised that as long as the sibling is in this world the twins will meet again, and that she would not let the Traveler search alone: "Wherever the hunt leads, I won't turn you down."

She offers practical world-saving advice: never on an empty stomach, and sometimes you have to take the world on your shoulders. She says her bow is the Traveler's, "now and always". Every year on her birthday she writes to the Traveler, in 2023 noting she knew no one else in this world well enough to wish her a happy birthday.

5.content: By April 2023 Aloy had joined the Adventurers' Guild. At first she got only trivial tasks, but after she took apart three Ruin Guards in front of the Guild, they trusted her with more interesting commissions. She salvaged parts from a flying Ruin Hunter and sent them to the Traveler. By 2025 routine commissions no longer satisfied her, and she went looking for a bigger adventure.

6.content: In April 2024 Aloy wrote from the Court of Fontaine, delighted by its meka: some look like humans, some like fish, and some can even dance. They reminded her of hunts back home. She kept parts from a mek she dismantled, hoping to upgrade her bow and arrows or build a new weapon, but Fontaine's craftsmen told her the parts could not be used that way. She concluded she still had a lot to learn and sent the parts to the Traveler.

7.content: In April 2025 Aloy went to Natlan, hungry for a bigger adventure than Guild work. Its tribes, hunting, monsters, saurians and untamed land were "everything I ever dreamed of". She grew especially fond of the Scions of the Canopy and asked them to teach her their climbing tricks, inviting the Traveler to watch her swinging across the cliffs. She sent trophies from her travels and repeated that she would come to help any time.

8.content: In April 2026 Aloy wrote from Nod-Krai, which she found strange but interesting, and was fascinated by kuuvahki powering all kinds of machines. She met a "robot girl" (Ineffa), whom she found rather cute and watched climb three storeys bare-handed to fetch a balloon for some children; a huge duck-shaped machine sat behind the workshop. The workshop's owner, Aino, she called a genius: they talked circuits and mechanical structures for so long that the robot girl had to remind them to eat. Aloy copied her notes for the Traveler. This letter is the only canon record of these meetings.

9.content: A uniquely designed bow that "should not belong in this world". A Teyvat blacksmith built it on commission and was puzzled by the strange girl's explanation about machine beasts and override codes, and concluded it was meant to bring down mighty machines. She corrected him: she meant to hunt wild boars next, since in this world bow hunting actually yields meat. Aloy carries it in her official art. Gameplay note: it was a PlayStation-only bow given out during 2.1-2.2.

10.content: Aloy's Cryo Vision looks unlike any other: a rounded four-pointed star inside a golden circular frame, worn on a sword-like pouch. It works like a normal Vision in gameplay. Canon never says how a visitor from another world obtained a Vision, whether a god granted it, or whether this design exists elsewhere in Teyvat.

11.comment: Aloy: Her world as she describes it
11.content: Aloy describes home as a place where not a day goes by without danger: giant machines everywhere, hostile tribes that always have it out for you, and evil machines bent on global extinction. She mentions the Oseram (one served her a stew "so thick you could pave a road with it"), and someone called Sylens, whom she would love to see trying to make sense of the Serenitea Pot. On birthdays her people honour the mother, not the one born. She calls her world troubled, "but it's worth seeing. And worth saving." She expects Teyvat's past to be as full of secrets as her own world's.

12.content: As a Serenitea Pot companion Aloy is polite but candid: the realm is charming, but she could not see herself living there long-term. She is used to camping in the wild, and the stillness takes getting used to. She would rather be out hunting before her "bowstring's gonna snap", and wanted to hear about Ruin Guards. In a tented camp gift set she approved of the tent placement and fencing as signs of companions you can rely on; in a rustic tribal-style camp she noticed an order beneath the crude furniture that felt familiar yet different.

13.comment: Aloy: Birthday letters and Satiety Gel
13.content: Aloy's birthday is 4 April. Her first in Teyvat (2022) she celebrated with Forest Boar steaks, saying all she needs are "my friends, songs, and meat". Each year's letter to the Traveler encloses a Satiety Gel, a cool, perfectly shaped mint jelly she once served the Traveler with some nervousness. Letters followed in 2023 (Guild work), 2024 (Fontaine), 2025 (Natlan) and 2026 (Nod-Krai).

14.comment: Aloy: Aloy's Exploration Journal (2.2 web event)
14.content: During a limited-time web event in October 2021, players followed Aloy's diary through three routes (the Mondstadt wilderness, Dragonspine and the Liyue wilderness), each ending with a boss. The diary text is not preserved in the sources read here; treat it only as evidence that she explored these regions early in her stay.
